entries.localizedLabel: Exchange one currency for another at a service counter
entries.localizedDescription: Convert a customer’s cash from one currency into another as a requested counter service; distinct from analyzing FX markets, receiving a payment, paying an invoice or the customer’s own currency exchange.

entries.localizedLabel: Execute or sign an agreement for a represented party
entries.localizedDescription: Sign or execute a negotiated agreement on behalf of a principal under delegated authority; distinct from drafting/reviewing/negotiating the document or personally signing one’s own consumer contract.

entries.localizedLabel: Fight and extinguish fires as a professional responder
entries.localizedDescription: Respond to and extinguish fires as an emergency-service action.

entries.localizedLabel: Fit wigs and hairpieces to customer requirements
entries.localizedDescription: Fit a wig or hairpiece to a client’s requirements; distinct from natural-hair styling and the customer wearing/adjusting their own wig.

entries.localizedLabel: Prepare and submit a flight plan
entries.localizedDescription: Create, complete and submit a professional aircraft flight-plan document for a flight, distinct from receiving a preflight briefing, approving another operator’s plan or navigating in flight.

entries.localizedLabel: Review and approve a flight plan
entries.localizedDescription: Examine a flight plan and approve/clear it for operational use in the relevant aviation role, distinct from preparing/submitting the plan, general air-traffic control and a preflight briefing.
Collect or analyse operational data about work methods, sequence, resource use and productivity to improve efficiency/safety; distinct from general project resource planning or process documentation.

entries.localizedLabel: Assess insured loss, damage and policy liability
entries.localizedDescription: Assess the extent of insured loss/damage and the liability of an insurer/underwriter under policy coverage; distinct from generic cost estimation, claim-file administration, and the insured claimant’s personal claim handling.

entries.localizedLabel: Assess customer insurance needs and insurable risk
entries.localizedDescription: Elicit a customer’s circumstances and determine the type/degree of insurance coverage and risk required; distinct from customer-side insurance administration, explaining/quoting a product, or handling a claim.

Observe and track how laboratory consumables are being used over time to control remaining quantity/quality and anticipate project needs. Keep separate from sample testing, receiving a delivery, retail stocktaking and project cost estimation.

entries.localizedLabel: Develop, standardize and validate laboratory methods
entries.localizedDescription: Create, standardize, evaluate or modify laboratory procedures, methods and tests, including checking result accuracy; distinct from preparing a session, conducting a test or following an established protocol.

entries.localizedLabel: Label pharmaceutical preparations for professional stock
entries.localizedDescription: Apply or prepare identification labels for drugs, chemicals or pharmaceutical preparations handled in professional stock; distinct from compounding a product, dispensing it to a recipient, recording a care event, and replenishing shelves.

entries.localizedLabel: Gather law-enforcement intelligence for crime prevention/investigation
entries.localizedDescription: Research, verify and compile information about alleged offences or security concerns.

entries.localizedLabel: Collect and maintain animal health/care records
entries.localizedDescription: Record animal weight, condition, treatments, medication and feeding information in animal-care work; distinct from human clinical documentation and an owner’s pet log.

entries.localizedLabel: Maintain records of securities transactions for a client or employer
entries.localizedDescription: Maintain transaction/position records of bonds, shares or other securities bought or sold for a client/employer; distinct from executing trades, advising on investments, and generic accounting that does not expose this financial register subtype.

entries.localizedLabel: Persuade a customer to stop drinking, decline further service, and order transportation
entries.localizedDescription: As a service provider, intervene to limit a customer's alcohol consumption by asking them to stop drinking, declining further service and arranging transportation.

entries.localizedLabel: Modify an existing technical device or system
entries.localizedDescription: Alter the configuration or construction of an existing technical device or system, including navigation equipment and prosthetic or supportive devices. Modification is distinct from routine adjustment, repair and assembling a new product.

entries.localizedLabel: Monitor contract performance and service fulfilment
entries.localizedDescription: Track whether a counterparty makes an agreed service available in the required format and time and escalate deviations; distinct from drafting/reviewing a contract, signing it, and providing the purchased service oneself.

entries.localizedLabel: Monitor culinary quality of dishes throughout preparation/presentation
entries.localizedDescription: Check taste, appearance and preparation quality of dishes throughout kitchen production and presentation; distinct from food-safety compliance, routine cooking and a final point inspection.

entries.localizedLabel: Monitor publications and select/file articles relevant to clients or staff
entries.localizedDescription: Review current publications, identify articles of interest to a defined client/staff audience and save/clip them for use; distinct from casual reading or archiving a collection.

entries.localizedLabel: Obtain authorization to sell at a market/street location
entries.localizedDescription: As a vendor, apply for/obtain required permission or license to establish a stall or sell food in a public place; distinct from the authority reviewing/granting an application.

entries.localizedLabel: Operate library/gallery audiovisual and reprographic equipment
entries.localizedDescription: Operate AV presentation/projection and reproduction/copy equipment in a gallery, museum or library; distinct from installing equipment, creating media content and producing a print run.

entries.localizedLabel: Participate in a media interview as an interviewee
entries.localizedDescription: Answer a journalist/media interviewer’s questions as an interviewee; distinct from conducting an interview, public speaking, writing promotional content and ordinary business communication.

entries.localizedLabel: Fit and adjust a prescribed assistive/prosthetic device for a patient
entries.localizedDescription: Fit a patient-specific assistive/prosthetic device and assess/adjust its fit, function and comfort for the patient, distinct from device manufacture, equipment installation, repair, calibration or the patient’s own use.

entries.localizedLabel: Place or arrange an insurance/reinsurance contract
entries.localizedDescription: Arrange placement of an insurance or reinsurance contract with an insurer/underwriter or insurance market; distinct from advising customers, negotiating terms, reviewing contract language and administering a claim.

entries.localizedLabel: Prepare a computer peripheral for a processing run
entries.localizedDescription: Read job setup instructions, select equipment/media/settings, load a computer peripheral and oversee run preparation; distinct from routine machine operation, software configuration and freight loading.

entries.localizedLabel: Receive and process orders for classified advertisements
entries.localizedDescription: Register a customer’s classified-ad order and apply applicable rate-card pricing before billing; distinct from writing/editing ad copy or preparing a customer invoice.

entries.localizedLabel: Process personnel applications for employment or promotion
entries.localizedDescription: Receive, register, route and process job/promotion applications and communicate the result as personnel administration; distinct from the applicant writing their own application, candidate sourcing, and the manager deciding whom to hire/promote.

Handle insurer-side processing across policy enrollment, cancellation, claims transactions, policy changes and associated payments. These are lifecycle transaction types under one selectable insurance-administration family; distinguish transaction type and role as facets. This does not imply underwriting, selling a policy, assessing claim merits, or a policyholder filing a claim.

entries.localizedLabel: Make a patient-specific prosthetic fitting impression
entries.localizedDescription: Create a patient-specific cast/impression/pattern for fabricating an orthotic/prosthetic appliance, distinct from clinical diagnosis, device design or fabrication from an existing pattern.

entries.localizedLabel: Provide professional beauty, cosmetic and nail/foot-care services
entries.localizedDescription: Provide client-facing beauty and personal-care services: skin cleansing/cream or lotion application, facial/body massage, makeup, nail care, foot-ailment care, bath-client service, and waxing/sugaring/depilation. The exact service and provider/recipient context remain facets; this does not imply diagnosis or clinical treatment.

entries.localizedLabel: Provide professional hairdressing and barbering services
entries.localizedDescription: Provide hairdressing and barbering services for clients, including cutting, washing, colouring, waving, styling, facial-hair grooming, scalp care and extensions.

entries.localizedLabel: Provide non-pharmacological pain relief within an established care plan
entries.localizedDescription: Provide provider-side massage or other non-pharmacological pain relief support (including pregnancy/labor contexts) under a plan; distinct from clinical pain diagnosis, pharmacological treatment and self-relief.

entries.localizedLabel: Arrange real-estate contract closing and transfer of property rights
entries.localizedDescription: Coordinate the signing/closing of a property sale or lease and the associated conveyance or transfer of rights; distinct from negotiating/drafting terms or performing the registry/legal filing itself.

entries.localizedLabel: Release pledged collateral after loan repayment
entries.localizedDescription: Return an item held as loan security when the borrower repays the loan; distinct from commercial product returns, inventory receipt and sale of defaulted collateral.

entries.localizedLabel: Retrieve, sort and route computer-processing output
entries.localizedDescription: Retrieve and sort output from computer programs and deliver the resulting data/files to the designated users; distinct from querying a dataset for analysis, transforming records, or sending an analytical report.

entries.localizedLabel: Construct, maintain and use a survey sampling frame
entries.localizedDescription: Establish and maintain registers and sampling frames that operationally define a census or survey population and support sample selection; distinct from fielding the survey or maintaining a general administrative register.

entries.localizedLabel: Scan or weigh merchandise and record its checkout price
entries.localizedDescription: Identify/measure a product at point of sale and enter or retrieve the price for the cashier total; distinct from stocktaking, product display, lab measurement and seller payment receipt.

entries.localizedLabel: Screen or triage meeting and appointment requests
entries.localizedDescription: Review incoming requests for a meeting or appointment, decide whether/when they should proceed or be routed, and prioritize them before calendar scheduling. Distinct from reading/routing correspondence alone and from booking an already accepted meeting.

entries.localizedLabel: Assess wagering risk, set odds and manage bookmaker exposure
entries.localizedDescription: Estimate risk and set betting odds and decisions to hedge/decline exposure as a bookmaker; distinct from a customer placing a bet, financial reporting and croupier game facilitation.

entries.localizedLabel: Set retail product assortment, stock levels and price levels
entries.localizedDescription: Decide what goods/variants to carry, in what quantities and at what price; distinct from counting existing stock, displaying a product and executing a sale.

entries.localizedLabel: Set up kegs, taps and beverage supply lines
entries.localizedDescription: Connect beverage supply lines and tap kegs for bar dispensing; distinct from serving a drink, installing general appliances or maintaining non-beverage equipment.

entries.localizedLabel: Shelve and re-shelve library materials in the collection
entries.localizedDescription: Place books, periodicals and other library materials into assigned shelf locations for browsing/retrieval; distinct from warehouse stock replenishment and collection cataloging.

entries.localizedLabel: Select/specify materials, furniture and products for an interior
entries.localizedDescription: Select, specify and recommend furnishings/materials/products to meet functional and aesthetic criteria in an interior; distinct from purchasing them, creating a product, or designing the overall spatial concept.

entries.localizedLabel: Import/export or transfer records between existing systems
entries.localizedDescription: Move existing data from one database/software system to another; distinct from cleaning/transformation for analysis, designing a repeatable ETL pipeline and administering databases.

entries.localizedLabel: Verify buyer age eligibility before a restricted sale
entries.localizedDescription: Check proof of age as a provider-side sale-compliance step; distinct from government identity verification or the buyer presenting ID as a personal action.

entries.localizedLabel: Verify a hotel guest’s payment/credit authorization
entries.localizedDescription: Check a guest’s payment/credit authorization at room assignment/check-in, as a provider-side lodging control; distinct from processing the payment, underwriting a loan and the guest checking their own credit.

entries.localizedLabel: Verify property title, legal description and ownership
entries.localizedDescription: Examine title, lien, judgment, easement, contract and map records to establish the legal description and ownership of property; distinct from market-value appraisal, contract drafting, conveyance and general document filing.

entries.localizedLabel: Assist with artificial insemination of animals
entries.localizedDescription: Assist with the technical tasks of artificial insemination in veterinary or animal-production work.

entries.localizedLabel: Weigh goods within receipt, production, issue or dispatch and keep records
entries.localizedDescription: Measure the weight of goods as an inventory/transport control at receipt, production, issue or dispatch, recording the weight; distinct from scientific measurement, measuring/marking trade materials, and merely receiving/storing/shipping a shipment.

entries.localizedLabel: Operate a boiler or steam utility system
entries.localizedDescription: Operate a boiler, steam plant, and related auxiliary equipment to provide energy and utility services.
Extract rock, ore, coal, and other mineral materials.
Carry out blasting or material-fragmentation work at a mining, construction, or demolition site.

entries.localizedLabel: Process ore and extract mineral products
entries.localizedDescription: Process mineral raw material, separating and preparing useful products or concentrates.
Clear agricultural drainage ditches to maintain the land.
Harvest timber in a forest by felling trees, removing branches, and preparing trunks for further processing.

entries.localizedLabel: Watch for fires in a forest area
entries.localizedDescription: Monitor a forest area to detect and report signs of fire.

entries.localizedLabel: Prepare a forest site and regenerate woodland
entries.localizedDescription: Assess and prepare a forest site for regeneration, establish new stands, and tend young growth. Species, site, and stage of work can be specified separately.

entries.localizedLabel: Gather, stack, or move hay and straw
entries.localizedDescription: Gather, stack, and move hay and straw for storage, animal feed, or bedding.
Assess farm animals’ condition and maintain their health through care, prevention, and appropriate veterinary support.

entries.localizedLabel: Prepare and maintain commercial fishing gear
entries.localizedDescription: Prepare, repair, and maintain commercial fishing gear.
Breed, raise, and keep non-domesticated animals in a managed operation to produce goods or replenish populations. Distinguish this from hunting and keeping animals for leisure.

entries.localizedLabel: Lift and position loads with hoisting equipment
entries.localizedDescription: Raise, lower, move, and position materials or equipment using hoisting machinery.

entries.localizedLabel: Secure and distribute a load in a vehicle
entries.localizedDescription: Place and secure cargo in a vehicle and distribute it for transport.

entries.localizedLabel: Convert paper and cardboard into finished products
entries.localizedDescription: Convert sheet or roll paper and cardboard into containers, bags, envelopes, and other finished products; distinguish this from packaging finished goods.
Forge and shape metal blanks and products.

entries.localizedLabel: Make concrete, stone, or mineral construction products
entries.localizedDescription: Make and finish precast concrete, artificial-stone, and other mineral construction products.

entries.localizedLabel: Make a foundry mold or core
entries.localizedDescription: Make, prepare, and repair foundry molds and cores used to produce metal goods.
Produce pulp and paper sheets from cellulosic raw materials.
Mold and manufacture parts and products from plastic.
Manufacture parts and products from rubber.
Manufacture semiconductor chips and components.

entries.localizedLabel: Plate or coat a product surface
entries.localizedDescription: Apply a protective or decorative coating to a product, including electroplating and metallized coatings.

entries.localizedLabel: Process tobacco: prepare raw tobacco or manufacture tobacco products
entries.localizedDescription: Prepare raw tobacco or manufacture tobacco products. The recorded activity can be further identified by its processing stage.

entries.localizedLabel: Manufacture or process formulated chemical products
entries.localizedDescription: Manufacture or process chemical and other formulated products in an industrial plant. The product category, process and equipment can be specified separately.

entries.localizedLabel: Process primary metal by refining, casting, or forming
entries.localizedDescription: Operate or monitor primary-metal processing, including refining, purifying, casting, rolling, heat treatment and extrusion. The processing stage, material and equipment can be specified separately.

entries.localizedLabel: Process logs into lumber or wood panels
entries.localizedDescription: Saw logs into lumber and produce veneer, plywood, and wood panels.

entries.localizedLabel: Evaluate the taste, aroma, or sensory qualities of food or drink
entries.localizedDescription: Evaluate the taste, aroma, and other sensory properties of foods and beverages, and record tasting results.
Shape and process glass to make a product or component.

entries.localizedLabel: Tan and finish hides or fur
entries.localizedDescription: Process hides and fur into leather or fur material, and sort, finish, and dye the material.

entries.localizedLabel: Treat and preserve wood or lumber
entries.localizedDescription: Dry, impregnate, protect, and otherwise treat wood or finished wooden products.

entries.localizedLabel: Weave baskets and products from rattan, willow, or reed
entries.localizedDescription: Weave baskets, furniture, and other products from willow, rattan, reed, and similar flexible materials.
Wind wire coils for electrical and electronic components.

entries.localizedLabel: Wash and polish windows and glass surfaces
entries.localizedDescription: Wash and polish windows, shop windows, and other glass surfaces.

entries.localizedLabel: Professionally dry-clean textiles and leather goods
entries.localizedDescription: Clean clothing, textiles, and leather goods as a professional dry-cleaning service.
Apply plaster or similar compounds to walls, ceilings, and other surfaces, then finish them.

entries.localizedLabel: Assemble and erect temporary construction scaffolding
entries.localizedDescription: Assemble, erect, and dismantle temporary construction scaffolding.
Excavate, move, grade, level, and compact soil and similar materials at a construction site.
Prepare surfaces and hang wallpaper or other flexible wall coverings.

entries.localizedLabel: Rig and position suspended equipment or structures
entries.localizedDescription: Prepare lifting rigging and position suspended equipment, materials, or structures.

entries.localizedLabel: Join or splice cable, rope, or wire
entries.localizedDescription: Join and splice cables, ropes, or wires during installation and repair.

entries.localizedLabel: Clean and restore contaminated or damaged building surfaces
entries.localizedDescription: Clean and restore contaminated or damaged building surfaces by removing contaminants, mold, soot, or damaged layers.

entries.localizedLabel: Upholster or reupholster furniture and seats
entries.localizedDescription: Make, install, repair, or replace padded upholstery on furniture, seats, and other objects.

entries.localizedLabel: Couple rail vehicles and assemble a train
entries.localizedDescription: Couple and uncouple rail vehicles and assemble a train from rolling stock.

entries.localizedLabel: Moor a vessel and handle its lines
entries.localizedDescription: Moor a vessel and handle its mooring lines, ropes, and equipment.

entries.localizedLabel: Prepare a working animal for transport or farm work
entries.localizedDescription: Prepare a working animal to perform a transport or agricultural task.
Install, maintain, and repair overhead or underground power lines and electric traction lines.

A project or session umbrella chosen by the user for design, piecing, basting, quilting, binding, and finishing. Component actions may be tracked separately and concurrently as overlapping, non-additive views.

Stitch through layers of textile to join them and/or decorate them. The top may be wholecloth, pieced, or appliquéd; hand and machine quilting differ by method. Piecing a quilt top is a separate operation.
Measure, fit, join, or install wooden elements, doors, shelves, furniture, or trim when building, repairing, or improving a home. Payment and professional status are not inferred from the activity.

Carve a shape, image, ornament, or other feature from wood by removing material with suitable carving tools. Making an object, creating artwork, and restoring a wooden part can be different contexts for this activity.
Practice navigating slalom gates in a canoe on a water course, or take part in a corresponding competition. Recreational paddling and sprint racing are not automatically slalom.
Practice canoe sprint paddling or take part in a corresponding race. Distance, boat class, and event format are specified separately; gate slalom is a different discipline.

Practice descending a mountain-bike course, whether prepared or natural, in training or competition. Simply riding downhill during any bike outing does not necessarily mean this discipline was chosen.

Practice enduro mountain biking or take part in an enduro competition. A competition session typically combines timed downhill stages and transfers; the event, not this activity card, defines its specific rules.
Ride a mountain bike on trails and off-road routes in a trail-riding style. This may be independent recreational riding without a race; location, surface, and intensity are optional details.
Ride a mountain bike in a cross-country format on varied terrain with climbs and descents. Training, recreational riding, and a particular competition format are specified separately.

Practice Nordic walking by walking while actively using specialized poles to propel and engage the body. It is a distinct walking technique; ordinary support with trekking poles does not automatically count as Nordic walking.

entries.localizedLabel: Compete in a handcycling para-cycling event
entries.localizedDescription: Take part in a para-cycling competition on a handcycle, such as a road race, individual time trial, or relay. Class and format are specified for the particular event, not inferred from the device alone.

Play POP Tennis according to the selected format of this racquet sport. POP Tennis, APTA platform tennis, and padel are distinct sports; the ambiguous word “paddle” alone does not establish which one was chosen.

Perform a chosen qigong practice involving movement and/or held postures, breath work, and attention. Forms may be more active or more still; purpose and tradition are not inferred automatically, and no therapeutic effect is promised.

Practice race walking as an athletics discipline with defined requirements for ground contact and a straightened leg. Training and competition differ by context; Nordic walking with poles is a different activity.

entries.localizedLabel: Take part in an athletics relay
entries.localizedDescription: Compete in a team relay race; distance and mode of movement are subordinate discipline and format facets.
Hunt fish underwater. The diving method is specified separately; breath-holding without hunting and observing the underwater environment are different activities.

entries.localizedLabel: Do fast or interval wheelchair propulsion for fitness
entries.localizedDescription: Propel a manual wheelchair for exercise in a chosen fast or interval-based training mode. “Run” does not mean running on foot, imply a universal speed, or establish medical status.

entries.localizedLabel: Do leisure-pace wheelchair propulsion for fitness
entries.localizedDescription: Propel a manual wheelchair for exercise at a chosen walking pace. This is the person’s own physical practice; everyday mobility, accompanying another person, and racing are distinct contexts.

entries.localizedLabel: Practice or compete in automotive slalom
entries.localizedDescription: Drive a car around a closed course through a marked sequence of cones or other control markers, negotiating them in order with accuracy and control; the run may be timed and include penalties. Practice and competition belong to the same base activity; rules for a specific event are specified separately.

entries.localizedLabel: Navigate a powered recreational boat on a route (UIM Pleasure Navigation)
entries.localizedDescription: As the operator or pilot of a powered recreational boat, actively plan and steer it along a route or course when route handling or navigation practice is itself the activity. This includes UIM regularity or course competitions, social rallies, training, demonstrations, skill checks, and intentional non-competitive navigation practice. A chosen destination alone, a trip made to get somewhere, or a passenger cruise does not constitute this separate activity; rowing, sailing, and closed-course motorboat racing are also excluded.

entries.localizedLabel: Take part in Pom performance cheer
Take part in Hip Hop performance cheer
Take part in Jazz performance cheer
Take part in High Kick performance cheer
Ride speedway, long track, flat track, or ice speedway
Race in solar- or electric-powered boats
Adaptive rowing (on water or an ergometer; specify)
Medical, dental, prosthetic, and assistive devices
Type or genre of reading material
Type or genre of video content
Participation in an event or ceremony
Institutional or project context of the activity
